_comment: Lebanon FMCG distributors/industrial groups pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot is the only change from the source text. No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope the month is going well for you. I've been studying how distribution works in Lebanon, and I've noticed a pattern most people treat as normal: the rep builds each shop's order from memory, and at the end of the month the office discovers which shops under-ordered and which ones still haven't paid. Two quiet leaks, every single cycle, across hundreds of points of sale.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where a business is losing time and money and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Would you be open to a 20 minute call so we can go through the details together? You can also reach me directly on +961 76 412 978, whichever is easier.

Best,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
Instagram: dave.automates
